skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Melodic Portrayal
skins.content: Cambrian 1099 New Winter Collection/Melodic Portrayal. Stylishly loose-fitting, comfortable and mobile. The waterproof surface keeps it from being stained by paint, making it the ideal outfit for artists.
skins.quote: Deepcolor describes epic scenes while fiddling with the strange terminal. Gradually, you begin to see visions of a silhouette fighting strange foes. You do not know if this came from reality, or fiction.
